revisions.name: $handle_PeekMessageA_fetch
revisions.reason: Review 20261125 TrackMouseEvent: before scanning the queue, $tme_poll checks this thread's tracking record (shared-memory TME_THREAD_STATE, indexed by guest thread id) against the cursor and, when the mouse has left or rested for the hover time, appends WM_MOUSELEAVE/WM_MOUSEHOVER to the tracked live HWND's own post queue through $post_queue_push. No EIP write, callback frame, stack, HWND lifetime, hook or focus changed; the posted message is delivered by the existing queue path, and callback ownership remains pending.
